name: Principal, Actor, Delegate, and Service Identity
description: Model identity types: human principal, agent actor, delegated authority, service identity. Each has distinct capability boundaries.
purpose: Identity is typed, not just a string.
acceptanceCriteria: Principal, Actor, Delegate, and ServiceIdentity are distinct types in the type system.
Each identity type has a defined capability boundary.
Identity resolution maps any identity reference to its concrete type.
No identity type can impersonate another without explicit delegation.
All subsystems use typed identity references, not raw strings.
